title: Story premise EDU091: The Address Bar Costume Party
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: The logo matches. What else needs checking? Takeaway/theme: Familiar branding alone does not establish that a page is authentic.
description: A shopper wants to return to a familiar service, but a polished lookalike page imitates its branding. A reviewed example shifts attention from appearance to verifying the destination through an independently known route.
